newsitem.title: USA: Parker Global Strategies acquires Ferrell Index.
newsitem.headline: Parker Global Strategies acquires Ferrell Index.

text.p: Parker Global Strategies said it has acquired rights to the Ferrell FX Index, a benchmark for measuring the performance of currency managers.
The index was developed by Virginia Parker, president of Parker Global Strategies, when she was director of research at Ferrell Capital Management in 1991, Parker said in a release.

Parker Global also manages the foreign exchange benchmark, the Parker FX Index. That benchmark is based upon Parker's proprietary model, which measures the unleveraged, or risk-adjusted, performance of managers who invest in currencies as an asset class, the release added.
The Parker FX Index calculates pure currency alpha, or manager skill, it said.
